confidence_notes: Restaurant and drink anchors are bounded medians from aggregator and crowdsourced sources. These disagree by up to about 2x and are not consistently dated, so treat them as rough. Cocktail and wine are weaker: wine glass has no direct source and is estimated from a reported bottle price with a typical restaurant markup. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates with no accommodation price search, so they are lower confidence. The FX observation was taken from the RBA exchange-rates overview as reported in search results; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; anchors are Puerto Vallarta-specific. Peso-denominated sources were converted to USD at roughly 17 MXN per USD, the rate implied by the Citycost figures. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates for a Pacific resort city in July, not based on live listings.
